description: Returns the 20 largest accounts of a particular SPL Token type.

parameters.name: pubkey
parameters.description: The Pubkey of token Mint to query encoded as base-58 string

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

result.description: An object with the following fields:

result.context.description: The information about the current state of the program

result.context.apiVersion.description: The version of the Solana RPC API to use

result.context.slot.description: An integer representing the slot for which to retrieve the fee calculator

result.value.description: A JSON object with the following fields:

result.value.address.description: The address of the token account

result.value.amount.description: The raw total token supply without decimals, a string representation of a u64 integer

result.value.decimals.description: An integer value representing the number of decimal places used by the token

result.value.uiAmount.description: The total token supply using mint-prescribed decimals (DEPRECATED)

result.value.uiAmountString.description: The total token supply as a string using mint-prescribed decimals
